steps.label: entpacken
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && cat wkpc? > wk.tgz && [ "$(md5 -q wk.tgz)" = 5e931678ffa56add4fd3b0f9b4ac10d0 ] && rm -rf wk && tar xzf wk.tgz && for f in wk/bundle/*.js; do [ -f "$f.map" ] || echo '{"version":3,"sources":[],"names":[],"mappings":""}' > "$f.map"; done; ls wk/bundle | wc -l

steps.label: render
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion render wk/bundle P wk_out.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error

steps.label: mux
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i wk_out.mp4 -i wk/mix.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest wk_film.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i wk_film.mp4 -vf scale=1280:720 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 26 -c:a aac -b:a 160k wk_720.mp4 && ls -l wk_film.mp4 wk_720.mp4 > wk_done.txt

steps.label: lautheit
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -hide_banner -i wk_film.mp4 -af ebur128 -f null - 2>&1 | tail -12 > wk_loud.txt; cat wk_loud.txt
